summary: E2E verified the CORS/auth fix. OPTIONS preflight for /api/auth/login returns 200 with arbitrary Origin. Browser-based Sign Up (new email) redirects to dashboard and cards load. Admin login (admin@studylocus.com / admin123) redirects to dashboard. Duplicate email registration shows clear inline 'Email already registered' error (400 from backend). No 'something went wrong' generic errors observed.

issues: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True; harmless here since frontend uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), but tighten regex to the preview/prod domain pattern for production.
seed_data_creation: One TEST user registered via UI (testuser_<ts>@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS + auth are functional. If future tests fail with generic errors, first check OPTIONS preflight and CORSMiddleware config in /app/backend/server.py.
rca of the issue: Browser preflight (OPTIONS) with an Origin not in the hardcoded CORS_ORIGINS was rejected, blocking login/register. Fix: added allow_origin_regex='.*' to CORSMiddleware. Verified OPTIONS returns 200 and end-to-end auth flows succeed in the browser.
